records.text: Christians, not Jews, were the largest victim group of World War II, and schools have deliberately taught otherwise.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: that the number one victims of World War II were not Jews, it was Christians. ... And when you say that, they get so angry because they have worked so hard for decades to manipulate people in the classroom to believe that the only victims that ever existed in history were Jews. And that's just on its face false and it is a lie.

verification.notes: USHMM documents six million Jewish Holocaust victims and numerous non-Jewish victim groups, many of whom were nominally Christian. The claim’s WWII-wide religious categorization is ambiguous, while the assertion that schools deliberately teach there were no other victim groups is contradicted by standard Holocaust education materials.

sources.title: Frequently Asked Questions about the Holocaust for Educators
sources.relevance: Explains the central targeting of Jews and explicitly discusses millions of non-Jewish victims.

sources.title: Non-Jewish Victim Timeline Extension
sources.relevance: Shows that mainstream Holocaust education explicitly covers multiple non-Jewish victim groups.

records.text: The Auschwitz Museum said that many claims made about Josef Mengele were fabricated and that he had previously been a respected doctor.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: about world war ii and the things and they panicked and it was hilarious because in a couple of months later auschwitz museum comes out and says the stuff that was said about joseph Dr. Josef Mengele a lot of it was made up he never did these things he was actually a before all of this respected doctor auschwitz museum puts on their website and

verification.notes: The Auschwitz Museum explains that myths developed around Josef Mengele and identifies specific fabricated stories, such as surgically sewing twins together. It also confirms his medical training and extensive criminal experimentation; it does not broadly say most claims were fabricated or rehabilitate him as a respected doctor.

sources.title: Doctor Josef Mengele and his experiments in the camp
sources.relevance: Primary museum account distinguishes documented experiments from later myths and describes Mengele’s medical background.

records.text: Owens alleged that after World War II, unnamed actors translated and edited Russian books into Western languages to conceal Russian history.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: that's why they had to. get all of these books after World War II. It was like a great reset. They didn't want anybody to know anything about Russian history. They started publishing, taking Russian books and translating them, meaning editing them into various languages in the West just to put up this wall.

verification.notes: The allegation does not identify the actors, books, translations, publishers, or edits, making a bounded comparison impossible. Searches for a documented postwar program to translate and alter Russian books in order to conceal Russian history produced no authoritative evidence. With no specific falsifiable target, the claim is unverifiable rather than false.
